decisions.reason: As a core box trailer line with clear fit to the firm's main market, it is likely to stay unless replaced by a newer generation rather than withdrawn outright.

The high trailer cover series supports cross-selling and customer customization across the trailer portfolio, though accessories remain easier to streamline than core trailers if complexity or margins become an issue.
This box trailer series still matches the firm's core business, but its overlap risk with another box trailer line makes it the most likely candidate for future portfolio rationalization.
